result.title: Reimagining Text-to-SQL: A Survey of Large Language Model Architectures and Strategies
result.summary: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries, democratizing access to relational data. Early approaches relied on handcrafted rules and template matching, while subsequent neural methods introduced encoder-decoder architectures, schema linking, and constrained decoding to handle increasingly complex queries. The emergence of large language models (LLMs), exemplified by systems such as ReFoRCE, Agentar-Scale-SQL, Snowflake's Arctic-Text2SQL-R1, and the modular XiYan-SQL framework, has dramatically advanced the field, pushing execution accuracy to new state-of-the-art levels on challenging benchmarks such as Spider, Spider 2.0, and BIRD. In parallel, modular frameworks decompose the task into sub-problems (schema retrieval, sketch-based generation, repair, and ranking), while agentic systems coordinate multiple specialized agents that communicate and dynamically allocate sub-tasks. This survey systematically reviews these LLM-driven approaches within a unified taxonomy of five paradigms (in-context learning, supervised and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, agentic and tool-augmented orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and reinforcement learning) and characterizes them by model granularity (monolithic vs. modular), level of supervision (zero-shot, fine-tuned, or reinforcement-based), and reasoning style (direct decoding vs. decomposed multi-step reasoning). We further analyze evaluation metrics, datasets, and open challenges, including domain generalization, efficiency, and real-world deployment, and we examine the role of the semantic layer in production systems. As LLMs increasingly access sensitive databases, we also discuss responsible AI practices. We survey over 100 papers and technical resources, focusing on work published between 2022 and 2026.

AI.brief_summary: 该综述系统梳理 LLM 驱动的 Text-to-SQL 方法，按 in-context learning、微调、agent 与工具编排、RAG、强化学习五种范式建立统一分类，并从模型粒度、监督程度与推理风格三个维度刻画方法，同时分析评测指标、数据集与部署挑战。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「schema 检索、草稿生成、修复、排序」的模块分解与 RL 监督，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、答案验证及停止与修复决策提供类比线索，需核查具体机制能否迁移。
